items.summary: marian-dev gfx1101 (Windows) e2e decoder fails: rocBLAS grouped-batched GEMM falls back to a generic SPIR-V (ISA000) kernel that Windows kpack_load_code_object can't load (hipErrorInvalidImage). Fix: add a _WIN32 && USE_HIP path in src/tensors/gpu/prod.cpp ProdBatchedTyped using hipblasGemmStridedBatchedEx (marian batched matrices are contiguous) or a sequential hipblasGemmEx loop -- ELF Tensile dispatch present for gfx1101. Optional platform; advancing head revalidates gfx90a/gfx1100/gfx1201.

decided.note: Ship as disclosed: the PR body lists the gfx1101 Windows batched-GEMM kernel-image gap under known limitations as an external library issue; gfx1201 and gfx1151 are unaffected.

items.summary: Upstream marian bug (pre-existing, identical on CUDA, not a port defect): PoolingOp::type() returns the literal "layer_pooling" for both avg and max mode and overrides neither equal() nor hash() for its mode field, so ExpressionGraph::add()'s short-term CSE aliases an avg_pooling node to a max_pooling node built on the same input in the same graph. Dead in practice -- avg_pooling has zero callers in the tree and max_pooling exactly one (examples/mnist/model_lenet.h) -- so no shipped model path hits it, and the code is CUDNN-gated. Found while writing the gfx90a MIOpen conv/pool correctness check on 2026-08-11; worked around there by giving each pooling mode its own graph. Deferred decision: whether to report it upstream separately from the ROCm port PR.

decided.note: Report upstream as its own issue (not mentioned in the ROCm PR): no existing marian-nmt/marian-dev issue covers it. Draft at agent_space/marian-dev-issue-pooling-cse.md; awaiting a person to run gh issue create (upstream write).
